title: Broken Cases and Disputed Delivery Windows: Exception Handling for Beverage Claim Agents
summary: A beverage claim Genie that keeps a mixed-pallet damage count and a disputed appointment as separate open questions, each routed to its owner.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Beverage claim agents need separate exception paths for quantity uncertainty and timing uncertainty. Broken cases require item and pack evidence; disputed delivery windows require the accepted commitment and comparable timestamps. Preserve unresolved branches independently so one verified fact does not make the entire claim appear settled.


Explore the complete[beverages integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/beverages) for the systems and processes around this guide.
